title: BACKND Base random search (RandomPool)
summary: Current random-search system using dedicated RandomPool data instead of scanning the DB: register/delete entries, fetch a random list or item, with optional group segmentation. Replaces legacy Backend.Social.GetRandomUserInfo and Backend.Guild.GetRandomGuildInfoV3, which are deprecated.
capabilities: route random-pick questions to the current RandomPool flow
explain why RandomPool is more efficient than DB-scan random
flag the legacy random functions as deprecated
prerequisites: RandomPool is enabled/configured in the console
Entries are explicitly registered into the pool
SDK is initialized and the user is logged in
common_pitfalls: Using legacy Backend.Social.GetRandomUserInfo / GetRandomGuildInfoV3 for new work (deprecated)
Expecting data to auto-populate the pool (entries must be registered)
Ignoring group movement of RandomPool data when a user/guild changes group
verification_required_for: current status of the legacy random functions
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route before generating random-search code.
Prefer RandomPool; treat legacy Social/Guild random functions as deprecated and verify before use.
public_notes: RandomPool is the current random-search system; legacy DB-scan random is deprecated.
Pool entries are explicit and can be group-segmented.
